shadows.default: none; use contrast, borders and film overlays

motion.scroll: parallax, pinned reels and scene scaling

must: Use only approved character sheets and supplied film assets
Keep Kuttappan, Shambhu and Pakru on-model
Use YouTube as the source of truth for episode metadata
Keep the primary YouTube action above the fold
Preserve Malayalam-first storytelling and reduced-motion support
avoid: Generic SaaS cards, glassmorphism or gradient decoration
Body marks on Kuttappan or misplaced bracelet on Shambhu
Mixing Shorts into the long-form episode grid
Loading YouTube iframes before the visitor clicks

decisions: Monsoon Matinee is the master direction
The hero plays chase, backwater and golden-hour films in sequence
The rest of the site behaves like an animated film programme rather than a marketing template
Primary character cards use model-locked cinematic action portraits generated from the approved reference sheets
